title: Website terms
description: Working terms for use of the pre-launch Impact Sol information website.
body: This is a working draft and is not approved legal text. The website provides general information about an initiative being established. It does not make an offer, create a partnership or contract, promise product availability, or provide professional advice. Visitors should not rely on prototype descriptions as a commitment that a service will launch or have particular features. Content may change as the organisation, rights and delivery plans are confirmed. Names, marks, interface concepts and third-party materials remain subject to their applicable rights; no licence is granted except as expressly stated in approved terms. Before public launch, the owner and legal reviewer must confirm the responsible entity, governing law, liability wording, intellectual-property position, acceptable-use terms and a monitored contact route.
